title: Source map and current development line
summary: The accepted v0.11 package remains the principal source map. Recovery ergonomics8 adds WireUIResourceBridge and a broader renderer-neutral Web control catalogue; ergonomics9 adds HTTP-front capture/compare tooling and session-readiness handling. Inspect these recovery additions as development evidence, not as an automatic replacement for v0.11.
invariants: Use exact package identity when comparing v0.11 and recovery-line source.
